decides: equality of terms reached by the rule cards and discovered laws; the cheapest term of the class (the canonical form)
limits: not shown equal is not unequal; conditional rules are left out
name: saturate

rank.general: are two terms equal in the equational theory of the rules
rank.question: whether two terms are equal by the rule cards within a budget, and the cheapest term found
rank.why: a rewrite chain is a finite witness, so equality is ∃ of a decidable check; the word problem is undecidable in general (Post and Markov 1947), so 'not found' is never 'unequal'
